title: POST /sites – request
description: Create a site. Supervisor token only (not through the site phone). The creator is assigned to the new site. Absent timezone: Europe/Budapest; absent no_data_alert_after_min: 120. Response: 201, api/site.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent.

no_data_alert_after_min.description: Minutes after the deadline of the last expected round without any data from the device before supervisors are alerted.
